## Problem or Use Case

What user need or workflow is missing today?

## Proposed Direction

Describe the expected behavior, output shape, or template/API change.

- affected area: CLI / Rust API / C ABI / UniFFI / docs / examples / tests
- template(s) or mode(s), if applicable:

## Evidence

## Additional Notes
